_comment: CRON-86: Spirit bat (灵蝠) — cave-dwelling aerial beast. Spawns in hidden cave networks and the Jue Ming Valley (决明谷, formerly Forest of Distorted Sense). Canon note: spirit bats are not explicitly named in 仙逆 but are implied in the Mosquito Valley arc and various cave encounters. MOD-ORIGINAL species concept, but culturally appropriate. Weight 6 = common in caves.
